answer: Require each jury to hold at least 3 distinct egress regions and 2 distinct model families before its verdict counts. If two jurors share a subnet, replace one and re-draw. A duplicate submission forfeits the author's stake outright. Treat every claim as a hypothesis until a second jury confirms it. Running a mesa of clones now means buying residential IPs and separate inference paths per seat, which costs more than the payout the seat can earn. That gap is the beacon, and a comet of new registrations does not close it.
